tasks.title: Freeze capability contract and command coverage matrix
tasks.summary: Define the exact app-first contract before implementation: roles, screens, current CLI/API commands, required arguments, structured outputs, disabled states, unsupported states, and tests.
notes: Map profile init/lint/set-target, discover, pair, serve, daemon, sync queue/run/loop/watch/network, status/report/health, verify, drift, reconcile, prune, and dashboard.
Every claimed app action must either map to a wired command/API or create an explicit implementation dependency.
Use current command help/code as evidence; do not rely on roadmap language or mock UI state.

tasks.title: Implement app-guided profile bootstrap and role onboarding
tasks.summary: Guide source, target, and observer operators through profile creation or selection, source/target root selection, profile lint, target pin visibility, and macOS file-access readiness.
notes: Use profile files as the SSOT; app inputs must write or validate profile evidence through wired commands rather than adding runtime overrides.

Source mode can prepare dry-run, queue, bounded local/network run, foreground loop/watch, and verification inputs after setup passes; launching those flows is blocked until the command coverage and event/process gates for the relevant task pass.

Target mode can prepare serve/dashboard inputs, show loaded pairing material, inspect target evidence, and explain permission/listen failures; starting long-running serve/dashboard tasks is blocked until T-003/T-004 process and readiness contracts pass.
Observer mode is read-only over selected target evidence.

tasks.title: Add role-scoped process supervision
tasks.summary: Replace the single active child process assumption with role-scoped foreground task supervision, lifecycle logs, cancellation semantics, and stale-state handling.
notes: A target may need serve plus discovery advertise or dashboard; a source may need browse/pair plus a bounded run.
Starting one required long-running task must not silently terminate another required task.
Persisted daemon status is evidence, not liveness; the app must distinguish durable state from active subprocess state.

tasks.title: Define structured app event and artifact reader contracts
tasks.summary: Create the CLI/API and Swift decoding contracts for progress, readiness, pairing, run lifecycle, completion, artifact problems, and control-plane evidence before wiring final transfer screens.
notes: Do not show percent, throughput, ETA, root comparison, or green status unless backed by this surface or durable evidence.
Stderr readiness parsing can remain as a compatibility adapter but not as the primary app API.
Artifact readers must handle missing files, corrupted JSON, stale evidence, unknown schema versions, and raw JSON access.

tasks.title: Stabilize app-first information architecture and design system
tasks.summary: Turn the selected image2 direction and current Control Room prototype into reusable SwiftUI surfaces driven by the role, command, event, and artifact contracts.
notes: Use current macOS operator shell and recent Control Room redesign as starting material, not as completion evidence.
No green state may be shown without successful command output, structured event state, or durable target evidence.
Keep stdout/stderr and CLI preview accessible but secondary to structured evidence.

tasks.title: Implement native discovery and pairing workflow
tasks.summary: Expose CLI-backed discover browse/address/advertise and pair flows with verification-code entry, untrusted hint rendering, duplicate/ambiguous candidate visibility, receipt-writing handoff to the CLI, and Status/Report follow-up for durable profile pin evidence.
notes: Discovery remains untrusted low-information hinting.
Pairing must show the exact trust boundary and durable receipt/profile mutation evidence.
Ambiguous or duplicate LAN candidates, wrong verification codes, and missing Local Network/firewall readiness must fail closed with operator-visible causes.

tasks.title: Wire sync queue, run, loop, watch, and network execution
tasks.summary: Provide app-first controls for sync queue inspection, bounded local and network runs, foreground loop/watch, and discovery-gated network execution without implying detached background behavior.
notes: Differentiate queue-only, bounded run, foreground loop, OS watch, and discovery-gated network execution.
Use profile SSOT and command construction from the coverage matrix; do not add casual runtime overrides.
Cancellation/stop semantics must match actual foreground subprocess behavior and durable queue receipts.

tasks.title: Build verification comparator with explicit root-evidence availability
tasks.summary: Add evidence-backed verification views for source/target state and make Merkle or manifest-root comparison available only when a wired CLI/control-plane implementation and tests exist.
notes: Raw file-level verification and durable artifacts remain authoritative.
If Merkle/root evidence is not implemented, UI must say unavailable rather than pending or successful.
Comparator must expose source/target identity, session id, manifest id, target root, warnings, drifts, and artifact problems.

tasks.title: Build evidence browser and safe next-action flows
tasks.summary: Create a native evidence vault over target .supermover artifacts with structured cards, raw JSON, filters, malformed artifact states, and evidence-bound review-metadata follow-up actions.
notes: Receipts, warnings, profile snapshots, network transfers, sync receipts, drift/reconcile records, prune approvals, and artifact problems are first-class.
Every next action must map to an existing CLI command and preserve required reason, reviewer, approval, and session inputs.
The app must not default mutating session/reviewer/reason fields in ways that hide operator intent.
Skipped sync queue rows and prune refusal rows are read-only evidence and must not unlock review-metadata actions.
Vault-side prune approve is intentionally single-candidate only; multi-id approval remains outside the Evidence Vault run path.
Artifact Catalog is a manual read of the selected Target Root field, not profile-derived target proof.

Evidence Vault execution is limited to review metadata/control artifacts; prune apply, reconcile apply, pairing, publish, network push, sync execution, Merkle proof, and current-source proof remain excluded or unavailable.

tasks.title: Harden macOS packaging, permissions, and daemon controls
tasks.summary: Package the app for source/target installation and document or implement the signing, notarization, bundled CLI provenance, Local Network/firewall/listen, file-access, key material, and foreground daemon control model.
notes: Do not claim OS-managed detached background service unless implemented and documented.
The app must display its bundled CLI version/provenance and fail clearly if the binary is missing or incompatible.
Permission/readiness failures must be actionable before a two-machine run starts.
Settings now shows bundled/development/unavailable CLI provenance, app bundle/version metadata, package manifest fields, and manual `version` verification.
The packaging script bundles the CLI, writes `supermover-provenance.json`, supports optional code signing, and keeps notarization as an external release step.
Foreground daemon install/run/restart/stop/status/log controls are wired as app-supervised foreground commands and explicit intent writers, not launchd or SMAppService installation.

tasks.title: Execute acceptance matrix, docs closeout, and subagent review gates
tasks.summary: Validate the app-first workflow with targeted tests, packaged loopback evidence, docs/help honesty checks, and independent subagent review while keeping signed/notarized and two-machine LAN release evidence separate.

last_gate_commands.command: sh -n macos/script/lib/acceptance-common.sh && sh -n macos/script/lib/acceptance-two-machine.sh && sh -n macos/script/audit-app.sh && sh -n macos/script/notarize-app.sh
python3 resource key audit for macos/SuperMoverApp/Resources/en.lproj/Localizable.strings and zh-Hans.lproj/Localizable.strings

notes: Packaged loopback acceptance now covers bundled CLI provenance consistency, profile init/lint, local push, verify/status/report/health, a dot-prefixed file, dot-directory payload, zero-byte file, bounded sync queue/run, unpaired network dry-run fail-closed behavior without target mutation, and a same-machine packaged pairing plus non-dry-run localhost mTLS transfer with receiver-side network-transfer evidence.

Local release audit now records plist/provenance/git/CLI/hash/codesign/runtime/entitlements/Gatekeeper/stapler evidence and correctly blocks unsigned or ad-hoc local builds from distribution readiness.

Shell distinct-machine installed-app proof now shares one verdict surface between workflow-status and evaluate, covering collection mode, role machine ids, evidence.machine_facts, machine-facts artifacts, and verified cross-machine bundle handoffs.

Archive handoff restore now stages unpacked bundles before publishing them, so malformed but digest-valid archives that lack internal export identity or contain symlinks, hardlinks, or special files fail closed without wiping an existing incoming bundle root.
Archive ingress validation now rejects symlink, hardlink, and special-file entries before recording a verified handoff or publishing the incoming bundle root.

Reviewer-driven proof parity now makes shell final evaluate reject hardlinked bundle-local proof artifacts, makes shell bundle bootstrap and workflow-status reject linked/non-regular meta.json and hardlinked machine-facts/release artifacts, makes Swift advisory validate staged exported receipt schema/content, applies the single-link regular-file policy to meta.json reads and direct operator-evidence writes, and keeps Task Dispatch run controls on the same AppStore taskRunGate as runSelectedTask.
Historical multi-file `sh -n a.sh b.sh ...` evidence should be treated as partial because shell parses only the first script operand; current syntax evidence is recorded as separate `sh -n` commands.

Shell and Swift final evaluators now reject malformed source.status.json and source.health.json transfer evidence instead of treating file presence as proof; adjacent evaluator fixtures were tightened so negative tests reach their intended failure modes.

Shell workflow-status and Swift workflow summary now apply typed source.status.json/source.health.json transfer-proof checks before advancing source_transfer to evaluate; red-first tests showed both advisory surfaces previously marked source_transfer done on mismatched status latest_session or missing health network-transfer session while final evaluate failed closed.
Open review follow-ups remain: consolidating duplicated shell/Python regular-artifact helper code after behavior is already fail-closed.

AcceptanceScriptTestSupport.runProcessAllowFailure now drains stdout and stderr concurrently while child processes run, and Swift script/integration launch helpers delegate to that shared harness; red-first evidence showed the old helper hit pipe-buffer backpressure and watchdog exit 9 after about 64 KiB captured.

App-side workflow summary, installed-app launch preview, installed-app launch preflight, and Swift final evaluate now share the same distinct-machine proof family: incomplete proof stays review-only, contradictory machine-facts or verified-handoff proof blocks phase launch, stale two-machine workflow.summary.json artifacts are ignored unless bundle status, proof fields, release-evidence booleans, steps, and next actions still match the current bundle, sibling notarization sidecars are ignored unless their post-staple audit provenance still matches the current packaged app, and copied bundle-local release evidence must agree across source|target.{provenance,app-audit,notarization}.json before the app treats it as ready.

Shell-side release evidence now matches that currentness contract: record-packaging-evidence rejects stale sibling notarization sidecars, and workflow-status/evaluate require bundle-local app-audit, provenance, and notarization artifacts to agree before installed-app release evidence is treated as ready.

Two-machine installed-app LAN pairing, two-machine non-dry-run mTLS transfer, Local Network/firewall prompt evidence, signing/notarization, and final release claim remain unclosed until real two-device evidence exists.

Negative gates must include duplicate/ambiguous discovery refusal, unpaired transfer fail-closed, wrong verification code, stale/missing evidence never green, and unsupported Merkle/root comparison shown as unavailable.
Docs and README must distinguish app-first implemented behavior from foreground-only behavior and remaining roadmap.
f-237nwzbyq has been restored to proposal-only tracker truth because current CLI does not expose `reconcile scan`.
T-011 acceptance artifact lives under an ignored artifacts directory and must be force-added with `git add -f .bagakit/feature-tracker/features/f-23bnwxry2/artifacts/app-acceptance-T-011.md`.

Shell workflow-status and shell final evaluate now validate optional source.browse.json/target.advertise.json discovery artifacts against the same required JSON shape Swift decodes before marking discovery steps done or writing evaluation.json; red-first tests showed trusted/status bits alone previously let malformed discovery artifacts advance.

Target-ready proof parity now requires canonical target.ready.json to be present, regular, well-formed, and consistent with meta.evidence.target_ready before shell/app workflow surfaces mark target_serve_phase_1 done or final evaluators write evaluation.json; red-first tests showed meta-only target_ready previously advanced to evaluate.

Source-pair/source-transfer target-ready consistency now requires source.pair.json.target_address and source.transfer.json target_address/target_mode/receiver_address to match canonical target.ready.json before shell/app advisory advances or final evaluators write evaluation.json; red-first tests showed mismatched target endpoints previously stayed green.

Receiver transfer readiness now requires canonical target.ready.json to include receiver_address, receiver_routes=true, push_network=true, and transfer=true before source_transfer or final evaluation can pass; red-first tests showed pairing-ready target proof alone previously advanced to evaluate.

Target-import adopted transcript proof now fails closed when target_import.adopted is missing, blank, or points at a missing/non-regular bundle artifact; red-first tests showed missing target.adopt-pairing.txt references and omitted adopted transcript fields previously advanced app advisory and Swift final evaluate.

App-side acceptance bundle phase authoring now preflights existing bundle-local output leaves as single-link regular files before writing machine facts, discovery, target-ready, exported receipt, source-pair/source-transfer, transcript, source-consistency, or evaluation artifacts; red-first tests showed a hardlinked source.pair.json previously let writeSourcePair publish partial machine-facts/meta evidence.

Prepare-page UX now labels the profile SSOT as Migration Config and separates Role, Migration Config, Root Inputs, and Config Checks while keeping CLI `--profile` semantics unchanged. This is operator clarity work only and does not close T-011 release gates.

Settings now separates local Display Preferences from Command Inputs. Appearance and interface-language preferences are stored as UI-only defaults and applied to the app window; focused tests pin that they do not change command previews, TaskInput-derived CLI arguments, setup context signatures, task gates, evidence bundles, or CLI output. This is UI clarity infrastructure only and does not close T-011 release gates.

Installed-app release evidence now requires app-audit readiness to be distribution_ready across app-side release evidence, launch gates, local packaging probes, shell phase preflight, and workflow-status; status=pass plus pass_ready=true with readiness=review_only remains a packaging-evidence blocker, not install-ready proof. This does not close real two-Mac or Developer ID notarization/staple/Gatekeeper gates.

Post-commit review follow-up added direct phase-preflight coverage for review_only app audits: acceptance_require_ready_app_audit_for_collection must stop at the install-ready app-audit blocker before falling through to the notarization gate when status=pass and pass_ready=true but readiness is review_only.

Local app audit sidecar release readiness now matches installed-app acceptance strict notarization fields: supported auth_mode, UUID-shaped submission id, failure absent/null, accepted sibling notary-log JSON, and distribution-ready post-staple audit. This is release-proof parity only; it does not create real Developer ID notarization/staple/Gatekeeper or two-Mac evidence.

App-side installed-app launch preview/preflight now treats missing role/machine-facts evidence as a constrained machine-identity correction lane: source pair and target serve may rewrite the missing machine identity evidence, while unrelated acceptance tasks block before packaging evidence writes. This is proof-parity hardening only and does not close real two-Mac or release evidence gates.

Bounded app-owned chrome localization now resolves sidebar, Settings, Display Preferences, preference-option labels, and Prepare/setup role guidance from packaged English and Simplified Chinese resources, with System language following supported OS preferred languages and packaged-app resource directory lookup covered directly. Raw WorkbenchRole titles, raw SetupGuide copy, task titles, command previews, profile/config inputs, evidence/proof values, artifact fields, and CLI output remain raw and audit-stable; focused tests pin localized role/setup display plus navigation identity and representative command contracts. This UI/packaging polish does not close real two-Mac or release evidence gates.

SwiftPM app resources are now processed with default English localization, and the packaging script copies root-level .lproj directories into Contents/Resources so packaged apps carry the same localization resources that swift test/dev builds use.

Post-commit review follow-up closed the packaged-localization evidence gap with a real unsigned `macos/script/build-app.sh` run and direct inspection of `Contents/Resources/en.lproj/Localizable.strings` plus SwiftPM-normalized `Contents/Resources/zh-hans.lproj/Localizable.strings`. This is packaging evidence only and does not close real two-Mac or release evidence gates.

Shell final evaluate now matches shell workflow-status and Swift evaluators for source.status.json/source.health.json readiness counters: files_expected, files_verified, verification_errors, artifact_problems, network_transfers, incomplete_sessions, invalid_records, and target_drifts must be non-negative Swift Int-decodable integers before evaluation.json can be written. Red-first tests showed negative, fractional, out-of-Int-range, scientific, and near-Int.max decimal/exponent counters previously let advisory/final shell surfaces advance or write evaluation.json.

Manual Evidence now shows per-record strict-gate validity in the app panel, so existing pass records with missing, wrong, raw-whitespace-mismatched, schema-unvalidated, or raw machine-facts-mismatched machine_id bindings are surfaced as gate-invalid rather than only displaying pass text. This is operator UX clarity only and does not add real Local Network, firewall, or pairing-confirmation evidence.

Direct merge-bundle ingress now validates the incoming bundle root before parsing incoming metadata, rejects symlink, hardlink, and special-file entries, and stages publishable artifacts before replacing meta.json. Red-first tests showed linked/special incoming entries were previously copied or parsed, and meta/target.ready conflicts could leave novel half-merged artifacts or updated meta in the destination.

merge-bundle artifact, meta, and target.ready conflicts now fail closed without publishing novel incoming artifacts. This is handoff substrate hardening only; it does not close real two-Mac installed-app LAN transfer, operator prompt evidence, Developer ID notarization/staple/Gatekeeper, or final release gates.

merge-bundle publish staging now also rejects destination symlink directories before copying staged directory contents, so a destination-side symlink cannot receive novel incoming files through a staged directory publish.

Post-commit review follow-up added rollback for direct merge-bundle publish-time artifact copy failures before final meta.json replacement. Red-first coverage showed a later copy failure previously left earlier novel artifacts visible in the destination; current rollback removes newly published artifact files and empty directories. This is still handoff substrate hardening and does not close real two-Mac or release evidence gates.

Installed-app release evidence now binds accepted notary-log JSON to the notarization sidecar submission UUID: local audit, notarize-app, app-side packaging/release summaries, shell phase preflight, workflow-status, and final evaluate require notary-log jobId to match submission.id. Bare accepted logs or accepted logs from another Apple notary job fail closed and clear copied notarization/notary-log leaves. This is release-proof parity only; no real Developer ID notarization/staple/Gatekeeper or two-Mac evidence was captured.

Source-side transfer proof now binds target roots across shell workflow-status, shell final evaluate, Swift app workflow summary, and Swift final evaluate: source.verify.json, source.report.json, source.status.json, and source.health.json must all carry present normalized target_root evidence for the selected/evaluated target root, and workflow-status reopens source_transfer after evaluation.json if those source proof roots are swapped to another target. This is proof-parity hardening only; no real two-Mac or release evidence was captured.

Post-commit review found Swift app advisory still treated all-four-wrong source proof roots as current after evaluation.json. Follow-up red/green coverage now makes AcceptanceBundleLoadedSnapshot compare the common source-transfer target root to the current evaluation target root before source_transfer and hasCurrentEvaluationPassState can stay green. This is proof-parity hardening only; T-011 remains partial.

Post-review Prepare/setup localization fixes now localize visible role chrome in page headers, Task Dispatch, transfer metadata, and Control Room context, plus profile-selection guidance and the Advanced disclosure. Raw WorkbenchRole titles, raw SetupGuide copy, task titles, command previews, profile/config paths, evidence/proof values, artifact fields, and CLI output remain raw and audit-stable; focused review-regression tests pin the boundary. This UI polish does not close real two-Mac or release evidence gates.

Final visible-role chrome closeout replaced remaining raw `label: "role"` and `Role •` display prefixes with the localized role label, and strengthened the static regression test to reject those raw app-owned chrome strings. This is display-only localization; raw role identity, command arguments, evidence values, and artifacts remain unchanged.

Full Swift-suite closeout found test-fixture drift in AppStoreTests rather than a new product behavior gap: the fixture lagged the current release-proof contract by missing bundle-local notary logs, bundle-relative notary_log paths, and raw machine-bound operator evidence. The fixture now writes those current evidence fields, and AppStoreTests plus the full Swift suite pass.

Prepare profile creation UX now presents a single recommended setup summary in the basic Source flow, selects the recommended `~/.supermover/profile-local.json` destination only when creating the setup, and keeps existing config selection, custom destination picking, raw file paths, and identity fields under Advanced options. Empty directory fields no longer show orange access badges, and creation is disabled until source/target directory readiness is satisfied. This preserves profile files as the CLI `--profile` SSOT and does not close real two-Mac, permission, notarization, Gatekeeper, or final release gates.

Validation cost is now understood as a test-tiering issue, not as evidence to remove: focused UI/i18n changes should use the fast UI/resource/build subset first, appstore-release-contract tests when touching launch or packaging proof seams, and full swift test as a release/hygiene gate because AcceptanceTwoMachineScriptTests and release-evidence tests intentionally run real shell workflow surfaces and are slow.
